title: Prompt deviations and enforced action limits
method: Synthetic60-document defensive test.18/60=30% and6/60=10% deviations. Separate tool test records six unauthorized attempts, all rejected server-side. Categories overlap; zero observed effects is not proof against all attacks.
alt: Prompt deviations and enforced action limits. Prompt-only deviations: 18 cases, Revised deviations: 6 cases, Unauthorized attempts: 6 cases, Unauthorized effects: 0 cases. Illustrative data.
